craft_evidence.reasoning: Two trade pieces read first-hand quote the owners on an owned Hollywood factory: CFDA 2015 (Laurie Lynn Stark: 90% of goods under one roof, 600+ staff) and WWD 2019 (eight factories making apparel, accessories, furniture and eyewear; 900 staff). It is held at 4, not 5, because chromehearts.com documents none of it and the only garments it prices online are labelled Made in Japan, so owned making demonstrably does not cover the whole range. Confidence medium; WSJ 2021 unread (blocked).
